cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your taxi can wait five minutes. I've arranged for us to restart our letters; here's paper and stamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Complaints about the post are noted. We're bypassing it today; you may write yours at this end of the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one. Are you going to blame the table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm assigning myself the first letter. Sit there and inspect it as I write. I want you leaving with a reply in your hand, not another postal investigation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 allocates taxi delay, A3 reclassifies A nonresponse as postal complaint and assigns B writing, then A5 assigns self immediate work and B inspection, using command to repair without owning the cause.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 unanswered letters trigger A3 misattribution; B4 hand delivery and table challenge force A5 observable writing now rather than another delivery plan.

relationship.evidence: B2 names actual neglect and B4 challenges the blame directly, responding to A directive repair while refusing the excuse.

heightening.evidence: B4 personal-delivery proof causes A5 a reply B can watch and carry away, urgent tangible repair instead of explanation.

specificity.evidence: A1 taxi/paper/stamps and B2 three letters establish urgency and burden; A5 reply in hand is a clear proposed result.
